constraint_event_rule: new arrivals that do not fit are declined, not queued; suspended returns stay suspended; closed recovery remains in history; initial overflow tabs start suspended; infeasible KEEP restore is masked
baseline_candidate_set: active-tab SUSPEND actions; WAIT if empty
useful_revisit_success: useful task-matching revisit events / all revisit events
ci_method: normal-approximation 95% CI over episodes; paired differences by common seed
replay_next_action_mask: environment-derived next action mask stored per transition and used in DQN target maximization
